newsitem.title: UK: Netcall to list on Alternative Investment Market.
newsitem.headline: Netcall to list on Alternative Investment Market.

text.p: Netcall Plc, a communications software provider, said on Tuesday it plans to list on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM).

The company, whose shares are currently traded on OFEX, a public trading facility managed by brokerage JP Jenkins which allows dealings in unquoted companies, will raise no new money with the listing.

"The move to AIM will assist in the continued development of the group and enable it to consolidate its position in a market place estimated to be growing at a compound rate of 40 percent per annum in Europe alone," said chairman Jeffrey Rubins.
First dealings are scheduled for December 18.
Teather and Greenwood is broker and adviser to the issue.
